notes: Ambulance: List I item 67 lists "AMBULANCE" as not payable, but Clause 4.1.1(v) specifically covers road ambulance up to 2,000 per hospitalisation; the specific benefit is applied (2,000 paid, 800 deducted). No age-based or other higher co-pay exists in the wording or schedule.
